topics.title: Core DevOps Concepts
topics.description: The vocabulary every DevOps interview opens with: what DevOps actually changes, why it exists, and how CI, continuous delivery, and continuous deployment differ.

topics.title: Docker
topics.description: Container fundamentals - images versus containers, Dockerfile authoring, Compose, and the client/daemon architecture underneath `docker run`.

topics.title: Kubernetes
topics.description: The control plane, the workload objects you touch daily, and the networking abstractions that make Pods reachable.

topics.title: CI/CD
topics.description: Pipeline design, Jenkins and GitLab CI mechanics, and the delivery-versus-deployment distinction interviewers love to test.

topics.title: Cloud Platforms
topics.description: Cloud service models and the three major providers - enough breadth to discuss AWS, Azure, and GCP comparatively.

topics.title: Infrastructure as Code
topics.description: Declarative infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible - state, providers, idempotency, and where each tool belongs.

topics.title: Monitoring and Logging
topics.description: Metrics, logs, and the toolchain - Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack - plus the conceptual split between monitoring and logging.

topics.title: Security and Compliance
topics.description: Shifting security left: DevSecOps practice, infrastructure and container hardening, and compliance expressed as code.

topics.title: Linux Administration
topics.description: The operating system under everything - commands, shell scripting, systemd, service management, and the filesystem hierarchy.

topics.title: Version Control
topics.description: Git mechanics and the branching models teams actually argue about, including how to resolve conflicts calmly.

topics.title: Configuration Management
topics.description: Keeping fleets consistent with Puppet, Chef, Ansible, and Salt - push versus pull, agent versus agentless.

topics.title: Scalability and High Availability
topics.description: Designing systems that grow and stay up: scaling dimensions, load balancing, auto scaling, and recovery objectives.

topics.title: Backup and Disaster Recovery
topics.description: Backup types, RPO/RTO targets, business continuity planning, and the discipline of testing restores.

topics.title: Cloud Native Architecture
topics.description: Microservices, service mesh, event-driven design, and the Twelve-Factor principles that make apps portable.

topics.title: Performance Testing
topics.description: Load, stress, soak, and spike testing - how to design them, which tools to use, and how to read the results.

topics.title: API Gateway and Service Mesh
topics.description: The API edge: gateway responsibilities, security, rate limiting, and documentation as a first-class artifact.

topics.title: Container Orchestration Advanced
topics.description: Beyond Deployments - StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Helm packaging, Istio, and the container runtime interface.

topics.title: DevOps Tools and Automation
topics.description: GitOps with Argo CD, Tekton pipelines, and the deployment strategies used to ship without downtime.

topics.title: Cloud Cost Optimization
topics.description: Reserved and spot capacity, tagging discipline, and the reports that turn a cloud bill into accountable engineering work.

topics.title: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
topics.description: Google's operational model: SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and the systematic elimination of toil.

topics.title: DevOps Metrics and KPIs
topics.description: The four DORA metrics and the measurement habits that keep them honest.

topics.title: Serverless Architecture
topics.description: Functions as a service, the operational model behind them, and the design patterns that keep serverless workloads fast and cheap.

topics.title: Database Management in DevOps
topics.description: Treating schemas as code: version control, migration tooling, backup strategy, and performance tuning.

topics.title: Network Security
topics.description: Zero trust, TLS, web application firewalls, and segmentation - the controls that protect traffic in and between clouds.

topics.title: Incident Management
topics.description: Detection through post-mortem: response plans, severity levels, on-call practice, and blameless learning.

topics.title: DevOps Culture and Practices
topics.description: The human half of DevOps - shared ownership, blamelessness, knowledge sharing, and collaboration that survives incidents.

topics.title: Infrastructure Monitoring
topics.description: Host and platform monitoring, APM, log management, and the practices that keep dashboards and alerts useful.

topics.title: Cloud Migration
topics.description: Assessment, the 6 Rs, application modernization, and the tooling that moves workloads without surprises.

topics.title: Advanced DevOps & Cloud
topics.description: Senior-level ground: platform engineering, FinOps, policy as code, chaos engineering, observability, and progressive delivery.

topics.title: DevSecOps
topics.description: Security built into the delivery pipeline: scanning layers, SBOMs and supply-chain provenance, image signing, secretless pipelines, and vulnerability triage that does not stall delivery.

topics.title: SecOps and Threat Detection
topics.description: Security operations for engineers: SOC workflow, SIEM and normalisation, detection engineering, MITRE ATT&CK coverage, threat hunting, and security incident response.

topics.title: SLO Engineering
topics.description: The engineering practice behind SLOs: choosing targets, burn-rate alerting, correct latency SLIs, error budget policies, and SLOs for batch, async, and third-party dependencies.

topics.title: SLA Management
topics.description: The commercial side of reliability: SLA versus SLO versus OLA, downtime and composite availability arithmetic, contract clauses, service credits, reporting, and breach response.

topics.title: AWS Engineering
topics.description: Depth on AWS: VPC design, IAM policy evaluation, ECS/EKS/Fargate, Auto Scaling with load balancers, S3 storage classes, highly available databases, multi-account organisations, and IaC choices.

topics.title: Azure Engineering
topics.description: Depth on Azure: the resource hierarchy, Entra ID and RBAC, VNet and private endpoint design, AKS, Bicep, Azure Policy and landing zones, Azure Monitor with KQL, and the compute options.

topics.title: GCP Engineering
topics.description: Depth on Google Cloud: resource hierarchy and org policies, IAM without service-account keys, the global VPC, GKE Standard versus Autopilot, Cloud Run, Cloud Operations, IaC, and the data services.

topics.title: Cloud Engineering
topics.description: Provider-neutral cloud engineering: landing zones, hybrid connectivity, least-privilege identity, multi-region resilience, multi-cloud trade-offs, DNS and global routing, and cross-provider service mapping.

topics.title: Platform Engineering
topics.description: Building the internal platform as a product: IDPs, golden paths, Backstage, Crossplane, self-service environments, adoption metrics, and safe rollout of breaking platform changes.

topics.title: Scripting and Automation
topics.description: The scripting layer under every pipeline - defensive Bash for orchestration, and Python for cloud APIs, structured data, and the tooling Bash cannot carry.

topics.title: Interview Experience
topics.description: How the interview itself works - the round structure, explaining your project, answering scenario questions, and the company-by-company record of what was actually asked across 85 employers.
